# Ongiini AI

> Ongiini AI is a free AI assistant on WhatsApp for people in Namibia — school, jobs, health, farming and daily life, in English and Afrikaans. It runs an open-weight model (Gemma 4) on a single computer the project controls, not a commercial AI API. It is the first project of the Common Intelligence Foundation (non-profit, being established in Estonia). The code is open source.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ongiini.ai/): what Ongiini AI does, privacy, FAQs, how to start on WhatsApp
- [Web chat](https://chat.ongiini.ai/): try Ongiini AI in the browser, no signup
- [Research — Ongiini-Eval-OW](https://ongiini.ai/research/): an open English → Oshindonga / Oshikwanyama machine-translation benchmark (600 sentences, native-speaker references); how to get an MT model scored
- [Statistics](https://ongiini.ai/statistics/): live, aggregate usage statistics; never individual conversations
- [Contribute](https://ongiini.ai/contribute/): help check or translate Oshiwambo sentences on WhatsApp
- [Check translations](https://ongiini.ai/rate/): the rating page for native speakers
